texts.work: Chronicarum quae dicuntur Fredegarii Scholastici libri IV cum Continuationibus

sigla.manuscript: St. Petersburg F. IV. 4 (contin. c. 10-24 appended to LHF)
Wien hist. prof. 991 (compendium from a codex 3)

evidence.quote: Omnes libri qui sequuntur ex eodem codice mendis plurimis adsperso orti sunt.
Satis habeo dixisse, librum 3 ex 2, 4 ex 3, 5 ex 4 pendere, neque vero primarios horum generum libros iam exstare
Quod autem ad codicem 2 spectat, e libro quodam x pendet, qui periit. Illum e Claromontano exscriptum esse, valde verisimile est.
Tabula adiecta quomodo libri inter se cohaereant ostenditur: [diagram on p. 15 absent from OCR]

texts.notes: Chain 1 -> x -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 (each class from a lost primary of the previous class); the editor thinks x was probably copied from 1 itself, in which case 1 is the only top witness and there is no real bipartition. Stemma diagram (p. 15) is missing from the OCR. Witness coverage varies by section (classes 1-3 lack the continuations; class 5 has only book IV and contin. c. 1-24; 4z/5x are extracts appended to LHF).

texts.work: Historia Daretis Frigii de origine Francorum (Appendix I)

evidence.quote: Nos quidem codicibus 4a. 4b1. 4b2*. 4c1 et Guelferbytano, Gud. nr. 139 (W) usi sumus
Librum praestantissimum 4a in orthographicis quoque plerumque secuti sumus
Cum 4a ex eodem fonte fluxit: 4a*
Qui sequuntur tres libri, ex eodem exemplari exscripti, fere ad verbum inter se consentiunt.
Tres libri qui sequuntur ex eodem fonte pendent.

texts.notes: The Dares preface states no filiation; groupings are taken from the Fredegar preface (class 4 subgroups 4a/4b/4c), whose mutual relation is never stated, so each subgroup is treated as a top branch (classes_only). W is said (p. 14) to derive from a codex 4a.

Roma Minerva A I 21; Torino 585; Modena; Pistoia; Petavianus (not classed)

evidence.quote: facile apparet, omnes codices A 1 ex eodem libro fluxisse, qui pro autographo minime habendus est.
Inter se libri A 1 ita cohaerent, ut A 1b et A 1c ex eodem codice exscripti sint, qui ab A 1a differebat.
Quod ad A 2 pertinet, neque cum A 1 neque cum A 3 menda communicat
Codices A 3 omnes ex eodem exemplari ... corrupto atque interpolato originem traxerunt, quod ex codice quodam A 2 simili fluxisse videtur.
[stemma A, OCR garbled:] Codex autographus. ... A3x / A3a / A3b / A3bx / (A 3β A 3*β; ex B suppl.)
Restat igitur codex Camaracensis (A 2), qui re vera libro, unde B fluxit, simillimus est.
Inter se libri B ita coniuncti sunt, ut sola classis B 1 e codice integro fluxerit, dum B 2 libro originem debet, qui locis quibusdam interpolatus atque corruptus erat.
[stemma B, OCR garbled:] A2x / A2 B ... B 2c1

texts.notes: Two printed stemmata (A p. 235; B p. 236) are garbled in OCR. B derives from a lost codex A2x close to A2, so B is placed in the A2 branch. Whether A3x hangs directly from the autograph or under the A2-like node is ambiguous ('ex codice quodam A 2 simili'); check the printed diagram. Contamination inside B2 (B2b1, B2b2, B2c1 corrected against B1b). Several B2c sub-sigla are OCR-garbled and reconstructed.

sigla.manuscript: later hand in A1 corrected to a C-like exemplar

evidence.quote: Codices qui supersunt permultos in tres classes distinxi, quae quam maxime inter se differunt.
nullo modo dubitandum erat, quin A ut genuinam recensionem sequerer, B ut interpolatam notis adscriberem.
E codicibus A unus tantum A 1 integrum exhibet textum, qui in omnibus libris A 2 locis nonnullis interpolatus est
In codicibus A 2c.d.δ.e.f. textus magis corruptus est ... Ex his A 2d et A 2δ inter se affinitate coniuncti sunt ... item A 2e et A 2f
procul dubio codicem A 1 adhibuit [interpolator C], cuius textum totum immutavit

texts.notes: Classes A (genuine), B (interpolated recension), C (later recension made from codex A1 itself). No common A-archetype against B is argued explicitly; A vs B taken as the top split. Codices 11-19 listed but not classified or used.

evidence.quote: Codex S. Germani Pratensis, quo Mabillon usus est, certe Bruxellensi aliquanto deterior erat
satis habuimus, Mabillonii textum ex 2 transcriptum ad codicem 1 emendare.

texts.notes: Two witnesses only, one via Mabillon's edition; three late Paris/Cheltenham codices mentioned but unused. No filiation.

evidence.quote: Textum cum duobus codicibus conferendum curavi.

texts.notes: 1 judged better than 2; no relationship stated.

texts.work: De vita S. Radegundis liber I (Venantius Fortunatus)

evidence.quote: Inter tot codices 1a.b. 2 tantum a graviore interpolatione immunes sunt, duo autem illi tam arte inter se coniuncti, ut pro uno fere exemplari sint.
Itaque 1a ex codice 1b simili et exscriptus et emendatus videtur esse. His codex 2 accedit
Interpolatos in tres classes distribui has 3a.b.c.d — 4a.b — 5
Libros 3 et 4 ex eodem exemplari ortos esse, non negarim ... Codices 5 procul dubio e 4 fluxerunt

texts.notes: Editor groups uninterpolated 1a.b and 2 against interpolated 3/4/5 but does not say whether 2 shares an ancestor with 1a.b or with 3-5; recorded as three branches. 3+4 common exemplar stated only hesitantly ('non negarim').

texts.work: De vita S. Radegundis liber II (Baudonivia)

evidence.quote: In libro Baudoniviano cum codicibus 3 destitutus essem, libris 1 et 2 inter se dissentientibus, persaepe haesitavi.
Cum autem propior affinitas inter 1a et 1b quam inter 2 et 4a intercedat ... hos consentientes, quantum fieri potuit, secutus sum.
Codices 5 procul dubio e 4 fluxerunt

texts.notes: Pairing 2 with 4a rests on shared errors cited (munitica 2.4a; Post totam congregationem 2.4a) and the 'propior affinitas' sentence; not stated as a formal stemma. Separate work/author from book I, same manuscripts.

evidence.quote: Codices in duas classes divisi.
Huic classi codex Petavianus (1a similis) ... et Remensis (1b similis) ... attribuendi sunt.
Librorum classes 1 et 2 ubi inter se differunt, raro 1a.b. peccant ... saepius recentiores codices 2a.b depravati sunt

texts.notes: Two classes with no statement of how they relate; codex 3 (St-Omer, partial) and Paris S. Germ. 1085 are listed but not assigned to a class. Dresden shelfmark OCR-garbled.

sigla.manuscript: interpolated codd. (Cîteaux, Auxerre, Corneoli, Vallis Lucentis) via Mabillon/Bosch

evidence.quote: Codices Vitae Arnulfi in duas classes discedunt. Altera A textum ex exemplari optimo a tirone descriptum continet, altera B textum A a librario sobrio de suo emendatum.
Libri A 2 ex A 1 descripti esse non possunt
Hi enim libri neque ex A 1 neque ex A 2 orti sunt.

texts.notes: Two classes; B is a revision of the A text but independent of extant A1/A2. A3 (interpolated) and class C (shares features with A3 and B3) are not placed. Editor follows A2+B against A1.

texts.work: Vita S. Geretrudis (recensions A, B) cum Virtutibus

evidence.quote: Unde patet, codices A 3 ex A 1, non ex A 2, fluxisse.
Omnes libri A eodem mendo laborant in Vita c. 3
Librarius B codice usus est A 1 simili
Auctor codicem quendam A 3 ita interpolavit

texts.notes: Recension A printed in parallel with B; Virtutes only in A codices; C (later rewrite) not edited. Grouping B with A1 rests on 'A 1 simili' (could be a sibling of A1); C from an A3 codex. Check whether 'ex A1' means A1 itself or its line.

evidence.quote: Codices A 3a.b.c eodem modo interpolati atque iisdem mendis inquinati sunt, e quibus A 3b.c magis inter se cohaerent. Neque vero A 3b.c ex A 3a fluxerunt

texts.notes: Continuation (to a. 783) transmitted only in A3; editor follows A3a.

texts.work: Vita S. Balthildis (recensions A and B)

evidence.quote: alter librarius B novam huius Vitae editionem paravit, sermonem expoliens atque clariorem reddens.
Omnes enim, qui nobis noti sunt, codices diverso modo et immutati et interpolati sunt.
Libri A 3a.b textum eodem modo retractatum praebent
Codicibus A 1. 2. 3 inter se consentientibus, res decisa erat, sed, quotienscumque inter se dissentiebant, ad textum B refugiens

texts.notes: No stemma; editor treats A1, A2, A3 as independent and uses recension B (a reworking of A) as arbiter, so B is recorded as a fourth branch. B sub-sigla 2a-2d suggest a B2 group but no relation is stated; C unplaced.
